# Lavendar Lewis

## Overview

- **Age:** Forty-five  <sub>[v2 c21 P34](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0034), [v2 c23 P10](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0010)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v2 c21 P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), [v2 c21 P34](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0034)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v2 c30 P30](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0030), [v2 c30 P33](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0033)</sub>
- **Origin:** East Grafton  <sub>[v2 c21 P86](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0086)</sub>

## Appearance

Miss Lavendar is a little lady with thick, snow-white hair that is wavy and worn in puffs and coils. Beneath her hair she has a fresh, pink-cheeked face with dimples and sweet wood-brown eyes with golden glints. She likes to wear dainty gowns, such as red dresses or cream organdy with floral prints, trimmed with frills and laces.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P45](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0045), [v2 c22 P2](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0002), [v2 c23 P5](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0005), [v2 c27 P22](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0022), [v2 c28 P57](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0057)_

## Personality

Miss Lavendar is imaginative, romantic, and retains a youthful, girlish spirit regardless of her age. She possesses a whimsical nature, frequently playing make-believe and entertaining imaginary guests or a dream-child to fill her quiet life. She candidly admits to being proud and sulky when provoked, which once caused a long estrangement from her lover. Despite her eccentricities, she is warm-hearted, highly hospitable, and deeply affectionate toward her close friends.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P49](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0049), [v2 c21 P55](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0055), [v2 c21 P62](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0062), [v2 c22 P6](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0006), [v2 c23 P7](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0007), [v2 c23 P9](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0009), [v2 c23 P19](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0019), [v2 c27 P59](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0059)_

## History

Miss Lavendar Lewis spent many years living a secluded life at Echo Lodge in Grafton with her young handmaiden, Charlotta the Fourth. She spent her days entertaining imaginary guests, creating a fantasy dream-boy, and playing with the natural echoes across the river. One autumn afternoon, Anne Shirley and Diana Barry accidentally stumbled upon her home while lost. Finding a kindred imaginative spirit in Anne, Miss Lavendar formed a warm friendship with the young girls, who began visiting her regularly. Through Anne, Miss Lavendar met Paul Irving, the son of her former fiancé Stephen Irving, and quickly grew attached to him. Learning of his son's visits, Stephen Irving returned to visit Miss Lavendar, leading to a reconciliation after twenty-five years apart. The couple married the following August in her garden at Echo Lodge and departed for a wedding trip to the Pacific coast, planning to reside in Boston while returning to Echo Lodge each summer.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), [v2 c21 P49](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0049), [v2 c21 P56](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0056), [v2 c21 P74](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0074), [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c23 P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003), [v2 c23 P26](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0026), [v2 c23 P29](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0029), [v2 c27 P59](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0059), [v2 c28 P35](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0035), [v2 c28 P71](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0071), [v2 c29 P10](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0010), [v2 c30 P30](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0030), [v2 c30 P33](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0033)_

## Background by volume

- Named Lavendar by her father because he loved the scent of lavender associated with meeting her mother  <sub>[v2 c21 P86](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0086)</sub>
- Lived in Echo Lodge, an isolated stone house in Grafton built by her father  <sub>[v2 c21 P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), [v2 c22 P7](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0007)</sub>
- Was engaged to Stephen Irving twenty-five years ago before a quarrel separated them  <sub>[v2 c21 P36](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0036), [v2 c22 P9](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0009), [v2 c23 P19](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0019)</sub>
- Employed a succession of young girls named Charlotta from the Bowman family to live with her for companionship  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>

## Quotes

> I was vain and coquettish and liked to tease him a little.  <sub>[v2 c23 P19](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0019)</sub>

> I knew I would rather be an old maid for a thousand years than marry anybody who wasn’t Stephen Irving.  <sub>[v2 c23 P19](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0019)</sub>

> I’m really a very happy, contented little person in spite of my broken heart.  <sub>[v2 c23 P19](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0019)</sub>
